Container.Name: jacaranda-offsite
Container.Overview: Append-only restic REST server reachable only over a private Tailscale network. Nothing listens on the LAN; all stored data is client-side encrypted; the image keeps itself current from upstream releases via its publisher's CI (enable Unraid's auto-update or re-pull occasionally).

Config.Name: Tailscale auth key
Config.Description: One-shot join key from the operator. Only matters on first start; burns after use.

Config.Name: Tailscale hostname
Config.Description: Node name on the private network.

Config.Name: REST auth (user:bcrypt)
Config.Description: htpasswd line from the operator (user:$2y$... bcrypt hash — not a password).

Config.Name: Metrics push URL
Config.Description: Operator's telemetry receiver (over the private network).

Config.Name: Logs push URL
Config.Description: Operator's log receiver (over the private network).

Config.Name: Download cap (Mbit/s)
Config.Description: Cap on incoming backup traffic. 0 = unlimited. Protects YOUR connection.

Config.Name: Upload cap (Mbit/s)
Config.Description: Cap on outgoing restore/telemetry traffic. 0 = unlimited.

Config.Name: Backup data
Config.Description: Where the (encrypted) backups live. Point at an EXISTING share on the array — deliberately no default, so it can't silently invent a new share.

Config.Name: Tailscale state
Config.Description: Node identity — must persist or the node re-enrolls every recreate. Tip: if your appdata lives on a cache pool, a /mnt/cache/... path avoids Unraid's FUSE layer.
